messages.author: Abdul Basit
messages.body:
Dear users and developers
I got four parameters for a single dihedral from AMBER topology files by
'parmed' command as shown below
Atom 1 Atom 2 Atom 3
Atom 4 Height Periodic. Phase EEL Scale VDW Scale
11 C ( C) 13 N ( N) 15 CA ( CX)
17 CB ( CT) 2.0000 1.0000 0.0000 1.2000 2.0000
M 11 C ( C) 13 N ( N) 15 CA ( CX)
17 CB ( CT) 1.8000 2.0000 0.0000 1.2000 2.0000
M 11 C ( C) 13 N ( N) 15 CA ( CX)
17 CB ( CT) 0.8000 3.0000 0.0000 1.2000 2.0000
M 11 C ( C) 13 N ( N) 15 CA ( CX)
17 CB ( CT) 0.0000 4.0000 0.0000 1.2000 2.0000
These four parameters correspond to four periodicities of the same dihedral
. Since periodicity is different, height of the potential barrier is
different. The question is can a dihedral have different periodicity? Out
of four periodicities, which is considered in a calculation? What 'M" in
the first column stands for?
Sincerely
Abdul Basit
Research Fellow
School of Computational & Integrative Sciences
Jawaharlal Nehru University, New Delhi-110067
India

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Sun, May 16, 2021, Abdul Basit wrote:
>These four parameters correspond to four periodicities of the same dihedral
This is correct, and expected. Dihedral terms are often the sum of
indiviudal terms of various periodicities. Each of the four terms is
evaluated and added together to get the final dihedral energy.
...hope this helps...dac
